description: 2036 is the Year of the Fire Dragon in the Chinese zodiac, from January 28, 2036 to February 14, 2037. Personality, Lunar New Year dates and numerology.
answer: In Chinese astrology, 2036 is the Year of the Fire Dragon, a Yang year. It began at Lunar New Year on January 28, 2036 and ended on February 14, 2037, so people born in 2036 before Jan 28 belong to the Wood Rabbit year.

sections.heading: 2036 Lunar New Year: start and end dates
paragraphs: Lunar New Year opened the Fire Dragon year on January 28, 2036, and the year ran to February 14, 2037. So a birth date of Jan 28, 2036 or later counts as Fire Dragon, and so do early 2037 birthdays through Feb 14; births in 2036 before Jan 28 still belong to the Wood Rabbit. That moving boundary comes from the lunisolar calendar, in which the new year starts with the second new moon after the winter solstice in most years, so its Gregorian date shifts by up to a month from one year to the next. Look sixty years either side and the pairing repeats: 1976 are Fire Dragon years too. That Monday new year arrived with the Sun in Aquarius in the Western zodiac.

sections.heading: What the Fire Dragon is like
paragraphs: Few years in the cycle carry the commanding reputation of the Fire Dragon. Since Fire generates Earth, readings describe ambitious, energetic people who inspire and expect others to keep pace. Those born now set high standards. Regular appreciation, a realistic calendar and listening to dissenters turn their pride into generous leadership. Their ambition is often matched by real generosity once trust and respect are established.

Belonging to the south and to the height of summer, Fire brings brightness, drive and visibility to any sign it colours. Classical texts connect it with enthusiasm, leadership and the urge to be seen and to make an impression. A Fire stem tends to make an animal more expressive, more daring and more openly emotional than its usual reputation suggests. People born in Fire years are often described as inspiring company and natural motivators. The caution most readings attach is a short fuse and a difficulty with slow seasons, when steady effort matters more than spark and the reward is a long way off.

sections.heading: 2036 in the animal cycle and in numerology
paragraphs: In numerology the digits of this year add up to 11, a master number kept whole, linked with intuition, inspiration and nervous intensity. The digits of 2036 add up to 11. The Dragon holds the fifth place among the twelve animals and its fixed element is Earth. Set beside the year's Fire stem, fire generates Earth, which readings use to describe how settled or stretched the combination feels. The year before was the Wood Rabbit and the year after is the Fire Snake.

Chinese almanacs name 2036 Bing-Chen, pairing the Fire stem Bing with the branch Chen. Both are Yang, as stem and branch always share a polarity, so of the hundred and twenty possible pairings only sixty ever occur, and each one names a single year in every cycle.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac is 2036?
faq.answer: 2036 is the Year of the Fire Dragon. It started on January 28, 2036 and ended on February 14, 2037.

faq.question: What if I was born in January or February 2036?
faq.answer: Check the date against Jan 28. Born before January 28, 2036, you are a Wood Rabbit; born on or after it, you are a Fire Dragon.

faq.question: What element is 2036 in the Chinese zodiac?
faq.answer: Fire, a Yang year. The Dragon's own fixed element is Earth; the year element changes every two years, while the fixed element stays with the animal.

faq.question: What is the traditional Chinese name for 2036?
faq.answer: Bing-Chen. The first part is the heavenly stem, which carries the year's element and polarity; the second is the earthly branch, which carries the animal. Almanacs, calendars and Four Pillars charts identify years this way rather than by animal alone.

faq.question: When is the next Fire Dragon year?
faq.answer: 2096, sixty years later, when the five elements and twelve animals line up again; the table also has 1976.
